description:
Functional specifications/files: extend nested/workflow integration to originate one X→Y→X case at real Mattermost ingress and to deliver real credential mutations across workflow-scoped runtimes.
Tests first: channel identity/credential reaches X and Y; Alice replacement invalidates opaque workflow/nested servers while Bob survives; subsequent calls use replacement; default answering global/required negative parity.
Branches: channel-selected configured/default Agent, nested run_agent, Person/system workflow, opaque scopes, targeted invalidation.
Mocking: external channel and LLM edges only.
Docs: executable test documentation unless contract drift.
Action reuse: not applicable — reuses channel routing, workflow run_agent, Connect notifications and Agent lifecycle.
title: Channel nested and workflow mutation credential integration
